title: Airbnb to Launch AI Travel Agent in 2027
excerpt: Airbnb plans to release an AI-powered travel assistant in early 2027 to help users plan trips, manage bookings, and receive support.
body_html:
Airbnb has announced plans to introduce a new artificial intelligence travel agent during the first half of 2027.

According to the company, the upcoming tool is designed to assist travelers across various stages of their journey. The AI agent will help users plan trips, compare different options, and manage their bookings. Additionally, it will provide ongoing support and assistance throughout the duration of the user's stay.
